verses.text: Ayxo tiempo manhxalaj owal syak' heb' israel, junk'olalxo yaj heb' yuj Jehová. Axo yik icham winakxo winhaj Josué,

ix schekan winh awtajkot masanil heb' sat yaj t'a heb' yetchonhab' winh chi', haton heb' ichamtak winak, heb' juez yet' heb' yajal yaji. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ha in tik te icham winak inxo, toxo ol in chamok.
Ha ex tik ix eyil tastak ix utaj juntzanh chonhab' tik yuj Jehová ko Diosal, ix stek'b'ej sb'a heb' yak'an owal ket'ok, palta a Jehová chi' ix ak'an owal kuuj.

Ha inxo ix in pukek' masanil lum lum tik t'ayex. Manhoknhej lum yik juntzanh chonhab' toxo ix ko satel ix in pukeq'ui, palta ix in pukpaxek' lum yik juntzanhxo chonhab' aytoeq'ui, skotnhej t'a ha' Jordán, masanto sk'och t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo b'aj tz'em k'u.
Ha Jehová ol ik'anel masanil heb' anima kajan t'a juntzanh lum chi', a exxo tik ol eyikejkan lum icha ajnak yak'ankan sti' Jehová chi'.
Hak'ek wal eyip he k'anab'ajan masanil tas syal k'ayb'ub'al stz'ib'ejnakkan winhaj Moisés, tz'akan wal tze k'anab'ajej icha wal yaj stz'ib'chajkan chi'.

Yuj chi' manh junnhejok tzeyutej he b'a yet' juntzanh anima aytoek' kajan chi'. Manh ex och ejmelal t'a sdiosal heb', manh eyak'paxem he b'a t'ay, ma he lokan sb'i yik tzeyak'an he ti', manh eyak'pax b'inajok.
Tzex ochnhej tzak'an yuj Jehová ko Diosal, icha ix aj ko b'eynhejkoti.
Ha wal Jehová ix ik'anel juntzanh niwak chonhab' ay smay tik t'a kichanh. Malaj mach syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a kichanh masanto tiknaik.
Ha t'a junok onh ix el lemnaj mil heb' kajk'ool, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix ak'an owal kuuj, icha aj yak'annakkan sti' t'ayonh.
Tzeya'ilej wal he b'a he xajanan Jehová ko Diosal.
Tzeyojtakejel juntzanh tik: Tato tze patikejkan el Dios, junxonhej tzeyutej he b'a yet' juntzanh anima chi', slaj eyik'lan he b'a yet' heb',

manhxo ol yik'el juntzanh anima chi' Jehová t'a eyichanh, palta to ol ex ixtaj yuj heb' ichok junok skan t'a junok yaal, ya ol eyab' yuj heb', icha wal syail yoch nok' tz'uum t'a yich ko patik, ma icha syail sb'at junok te' q'uiix t'a yol ko sat, masanto ol ex satel t'a sat lum lum te wach' ix yak' Jehová ko Diosal tik t'ayonh.
Ha in tik toxo ol in chamok, palta a ex tik eyojtak wal sik'lab'il to ix elnhejk'och masanil tas wach' b'aj yak'nakkan sti' Jehová ko Diosal t'ayonh, malaj junok maj elk'ochi.

Palta icha wal ix aj yelk'och masanil tastak wach' b'aj yak'nakkan sti' Jehová chi' t'ayonh, icha pax chi' ol aj yak'ankot masanil makanhil yaelal alb'ilkan yuj t'a eyib'anh. Tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej he k'ulan strato Jehová ko Diosal ix sb'o ket'ok, haxo t'a komon Dios ol ex och ejmelal, tato ha t'a juntzanh chi' ol eyak'em he b'a, ol kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'ayex, elanhchamel ol ex satjokel t'a sat jun lum lum te wach' ix yak' tik t'ayonh, xchi winhaj Josué chi'.
